import pandas as pd
from scipy.stats import pearsonr

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')

# Extract the composite deprivation score (Column B) and final rank (Column K)
composite_deprivation_score = df.iloc[:, 1]
final_rank_score = df.iloc[:, 10]

# Perform Pearson correlation test
correlation_coefficient, p_value = pearsonr(composite_deprivation_score, final_rank_score)

# Output the results
print("Correlation Method: Pearson")
print(f"Correlation Coefficient: {correlation_coefficient}")
print(f"P-value: {p_value}")
